message:
The proven retrofit for a lively deck is tuned masses hidden below the deck that push back at the bending frequency while the walkway and sightline stay unchanged, as built on London with vertical absorbers under the deck described in the ICSV22 Template (E1) and in the Millennium Bridge, London (E2). That working principle is the tuned mass absorber (C1) on the under-deck suspension (C2) with below-soffit concealment (C6), where governing choice besides tune and damping is absorber to modal mass ratio of 3 to 5 percent.

Resonance must be assumed because 1.9 Hz sits inside the critical walking band, with maximum comfort below 0.5 metres per second squared reported in the Dynamic Sensitivity of Footbridges: Modal Identification, Human-Induced Vibrations, and Emerging Solutions for Sustainable Design (E3) and in the Human-induced vibration assessment of a steel arch footbridge with tapered truss cross-section (E4), and with optimum tune and damping set by the Den Hartog relations reported in the 70. Seismic performance of tuned mass damper on Shazand Railway Bridge induced by train (E5) and in the analysis on the optimum performance of tuned mass damper eurodyn2014cdpapers241ms09abs.html — 2014 (E6). For this device that means Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) mass 800 kg from the TMD mass calculation (E13), optimum TMD frequency 1.83 Hz from the optimum frequency calculation (E14), optimum TMD damping ratio 12.0 percent from the optimum damping calculation (E15), TMD stiffness 105 kN per m from the spring stiffness calculation (E16), on a bridge modal stiffness 2.85 MN per m from the modal stiffness calculation (E12).

Added mass alone barely moves frequency while tuned action plus damping controls response, but tuning is tight and stroke grows if mass ratio is cut, so mass ratio against stroke and end-stop travel is the deciding trade. The free-decay simulation (E17) starting from 20.0 mm settles to near zero in 15.0 s for about 6.20 percent effective damping with 49.4 mm peak relative travel, which fits inside a hand width and below a door width while 0.5 metres per second squared is about 0.051 g and therefore a small fraction of body weight feel. My position is not ready, because load transfer, stop sizing and crowd verification by the other members are still open.
